title: Base overlays: list each changed non-Go or _test.go file with its own git show MERGEBASE:path command, and give a prompt-only diff the same hint

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Follow-up of S592 (run ork-20261126-004139-f69b). adj 596 (tool feedback, folded into S592 on 2026-11-26) asked that the Base overlays section give non-Go changed files such as role prompts a base-read command, or say that none applies. S592 landed one generic paragraph, git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:PATH, with no paths, as its spec said.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-26: list each changed non-Go or _test.go file with its own git show MERGEBASE:path command (Jon chose 'Land generic, per-file later'). Also give a diff with no non-test Go file (for example a prompt-only slice) the same hint; today the section is nil then (internal/engine/baseoverlay.go:55-57; S592 reviewer finding; Jon chose 'Fold hint into follow-up').
